fields.Name: Veteran's Awareness
fields.FlavourText: Know when you'll be hit, and you'll barely feel it.

fields.Name: Hollow Palm Technique
fields.FlavourText: "The mastodons of yore were each born with two weapons greater than any sword. So, too, were you." - Maraketh Proverb

fields.Name: Pitfighter

Lone Adventurer
fields.FlavourText:
Travelling alone makes one an easier target?
I believe not.
Travelling alone keeps one free of distraction.

fields.Name: Twist of Fate
fields.FlavourText: The landscape twists before your eyes, morphing into realms of unspeakable horror.

fields.Name: Wellspring of Creation
fields.FlavourText:
The waters of life roil and flow,
birthing horrors of flesh and marrow.

fields.Name: Dance of Destruction
fields.FlavourText:
Atlassian aberrations engage in a deadly dance.
Will you be joining them in the fray?

fields.Name: Unwavering Vision
fields.FlavourText: No deviations. No flaws. Only perfection.

fields.Name: Singular Focus
fields.FlavourText: You fancy yourself a god. You see only what you want to see.

fields.Name: Wandering Path
fields.FlavourText:
Embrace the journey, Nomad, for there is no destination.
This is the prime inescapable truth of eternity.

fields.Name: Grand Design
fields.FlavourText:
Ignore everything but your obsession, Nomad.
A mortal life is too short a season to entertain distractions.

fields.Name: Cosmic Wounds
fields.FlavourText: A single act of love and defiance may cascade destruction across the cosmos.

fields.Name: Throw the Gauntlet
fields.FlavourText: You must rise from mere amusement to respected equal.

fields.Name: Memento Mori
fields.FlavourText: When memories become twisted by a corrupted mind, history is rewritten, time after time.

fields.Name: The Perfect Storm
fields.FlavourText: Agony born of ennui. Hate born of love.

fields.Name: Thirst for Knowledge
fields.FlavourText: Constellations are systematically incinerated in the wake of an ever-expanding archive of minds.

fields.Name: Insatiable Appetite
fields.FlavourText: At the core of the mass, a fierce hunger seethes, as the Tangle's champion devours a myriad of worlds...

fields.Name: Height of Hubris
fields.FlavourText:
It takes either immense courage or unfettered masochism
to invoke unspeakable horrors, time after time...

fields.Name: Captivated Interest
fields.FlavourText: You had her curiosity. Now you have her attention.

fields.Name: Eldritch Gaze
fields.FlavourText:
You were drunk on the power of the cosmos,
until a hideous gaze settled upon you,
and tendrils began to unfurl...

fields.Name: Wrath of the Cosmos
fields.FlavourText: A fiery dawn illumines the horizon, and it becomes apparent that all that glitters is not gold...

fields.Name: Shadow Shaping
fields.FlavourText: In lieu of happiness, sometimes the absence of pain is good enough.

fields.Name: Valley of Darkness
fields.FlavourText:
Darkening mists shroud the pale sky,
blurring the barrier between nightmare and dream.

fields.Name: Inevitable Ambush
fields.FlavourText: The hunter must become the hunted.

fields.Name: Growing Hordes
fields.FlavourText: The weight of history hangs heavy on the neck of civilisation.

fields.Name: Extreme Archaeology
fields.FlavourText: Verisium is often found in a recent crater. Properly refined, it can easily make another.

fields.Name: Crop Rotation
fields.FlavourText: A good sword is worthless without a hundred plowshares behind it.

fields.Name: Timeless Conflict
fields.FlavourText: Haste is irrelevant in the face of eternity.

fields.Name: Unending Nightmare
fields.FlavourText: What if it's all just in your head?

fields.Name: Immutable Dogma
fields.FlavourText:
Do not doubt. Do not question.
This is the way it has always been.
This is the way it shall always be.

fields.Name: Arbitrary Tenets
fields.FlavourText:
They are unforgivable sinners and fools...
We pray each Sacrato. They pray each Kaso.
They are absolutely mad!

fields.Name: Endless Tide
fields.FlavourText:
You fight on, muscles burning, limbs leaden,
hoping for that singular moment of victory that
might finally bring relief... but it never comes.

fields.Name: Speaker of the Dead
fields.FlavourText:
For nine hundred years, they have had no voice, no hope.
Finally, they have found a kindred soul... in you.

fields.Name: Cassia's Pride
fields.FlavourText: She'll certainly never give you credit now.

fields.Name: All Hands
fields.FlavourText: The enemy is at the gates. Every single soldier we have may still not be enough...

fields.Name: Meticulous Appraiser
fields.FlavourText: Within every treasure can be found shades of gold, should one have the patience to look.

fields.Name: Lucid Dreams
fields.FlavourText:
Shattered fragments of reality float through the void,
waiting to be shaped by your mind's desire.

fields.Name: Destructive Play
fields.FlavourText:
She makes the rules up as she goes.
It was never going to be fair.

fields.Name: The Seventh Gate
fields.FlavourText: The most enigmatic threshold is not a 'where.'

fields.Name: Overloaded Circuits
fields.FlavourText:
"Supplying the Map Device with more power has... unexpected effects.
Somehow, though, I doubt you'll be deterred."

fields.Name: Bold Undertakings
fields.FlavourText: Fortune will rain upon those who bring humour to Chaos.

fields.Name: Gruelling Gauntlet
fields.FlavourText: Chaos smiles upon those who leave their Fate to chance.

fields.Name: Ruinous Wager
fields.FlavourText: There are many ways to win... and many ways to lose.

fields.Name: Unfettered Concentration
fields.FlavourText:
The mists of the Atlas offer up that which you
most desire... so long as you never leave.

fields.Name: Back to Basics
fields.FlavourText:
Some corners of the Atlas remain as they once
were, untouched by outside influences...

fields.Name: Thorough Exploration
fields.FlavourText:
A methodical explorer will find many paths
that others, in their haste, might miss.

fields.Name: Fear of the Light
fields.FlavourText: Lift not the Lantern, lest ye see too far.

fields.Name: Prospero's Wager
fields.FlavourText:
"There is none among us, neither God or Man,
that knows what we will find after death.
What better stakes for a bet could there be?"

fields.Name: Dimensional Foothold
fields.FlavourText: All across the land, the Hiveborn swarm.

fields.Name: Enemy at the Gates
fields.FlavourText: The hour of invasion is nigh.

fields.Name: Synthesised Stability
fields.FlavourText: Memories are the stuff of which dreams are made...

fields.Name: The Paths Not Taken
fields.FlavourText: Many fates await you... but some you will never walk.

fields.Name: Jumbled Abundance
fields.FlavourText:
You know not what you want,
save the hunger for 'more'...

fields.Name: Mortal Gateway
fields.FlavourText: Life and Death are two sides of the same coin.

fields.Name: Mortal Gateway
fields.FlavourText: Life and Death are two sides of the same coin.

fields.Name: Cryptic Gateway
fields.FlavourText: Thought cannot exist without Memory.

fields.Name: Cryptic Gateway
fields.FlavourText: Memory cannot exist without Thought.

fields.Name: Eldritch Gateway
fields.FlavourText: The curious gaze up at the stars...

fields.Name: Eldritch Gateway
fields.FlavourText: ... and the stars gaze back with hunger.

fields.FlavourText: Tainted blood is a gift that must be shared.
